description: Cargo crates, web/ packages and the release scripts' package.json (bun.lock), action digests other than zeabur-oss/.github's (the Update workflow moves those) and the Zeabur Identity release tag; the k3s test version, which follows K3s's stable channel, and the schedule, sign-off, the github actions, cargo (non-major) and kubernetes crates groups come from the shared preset github>zeabur-oss/.github.
